user.title: Connect to Telos
user.description: Enter your Telos server URL. Home Assistant then signs in as you, in one of the ways your Telos instance offers.

data_description.url: Base URL of your Telos server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3001

method.title: Sign in to Telos
method.description: How do you want to sign in?

menu_options.browser: Sign in with {provider} in your browser

email.title: Sign in by email
email.description: Enter the email you sign in to Telos with.

link.title: Paste the sign-in link
link.description: Telos has emailed a sign-in link to {email}. Paste the whole link, or just its token. Links last 15 minutes.

browser_retry.title: Sign in with {provider}
browser_retry.description: The sign-in didn't finish. Submit to get a new code and try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Telos again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant's sign-in for {url} has expired or was revoked. Continue to sign in again.

progress.wait_for_approval: Open [{url}]({url}) and sign in with {provider}. Check that the code shown there is **{code}**, then approve Home Assistant. This window carries on by itself once you have.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Telos server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.cannot_connect_provider: Failed to reach the sign-in provider. Check that it is running and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_link: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired (links last 15 minutes). Start again to get a new one.
error.request_refused: Telos refused to send a sign-in link. Check the address. This Telos instance may not be set up to send email (SMTP_URL).
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error.device_expired: The code expired before it was approved.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Telos account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different Telos account than this entry belongs to.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Telos server.
abort.cannot_connect_provider: Failed to reach the sign-in provider. Check that it is running and that Home Assistant can reach it.
abort.no_sign_in_method: This Telos instance offers no way for Home Assistant to sign in. Its admin needs to set up email (SMTP_URL) or a sign-in provider.
abort.device_sign_in_off: This Telos instance signs in with {provider}, but device sign-in isn't set up. Its admin needs to register a device client at {provider} and set OIDC_DEVICE_CLIENT_ID on Telos.
abort.device_start_failed: {provider} refused to start a device sign-in. Check that the Home Assistant client has the device grant and is allowed for the Telos API.
abort.token_refused: Telos didn't accept the sign-in from {provider}. Sign in to Telos in your browser with {provider} once, so Telos links the account, then try again.
